title: Detecting White Supremacist Hate Speech using Domain Specific Word Embedding with Deep Learning and BERT
reasoning: The research focuses on the technical task of classifying white supremacist hate speech using NLP models (LSTM and BERT). While it deals with content involving religious and racial hatred, it is a classification task measuring performance (F1-score) rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethical systems themselves.
